title: What Scripture Actually Means When It Says a Godly Man Has Nothing to Hide
caption:
Nothing you do in private is private to God.

Luke 8:17: nothing is hidden that won't be disclosed. The double life you think you're managing isn't two men. It's one man lying to himself.

What you hide grows. What you confess starts to die.

Same guy in the group chat, at church, and alone at 1 a.m. That's the whole test.

#faith #christianmen #manofgod #integrity #confession
